description: Maya is coordinating what to do with an old pear tree on a small family property inherited by the three relatives. The tree currently stands where Maya hoped to put a patio, so she must make the final call about the tree, its root protection, and what happens to its fruit.

shared_context.S1: The family property has one mature pear tree beside the area where a patio might be built.
shared_context.S2: Maya is coordinating the property plans and will make the final decision about the tree.
shared_context.S3: The tree produces more pears than the family usually uses during late summer.
shared_context.S4: The family is meeting on Saturday to settle the plan, and Maya's usual practice is to ask Jonah and Leah in turn for anything that should shape the decision before she commits to it.

PF1.text: An arborist Jonah consulted inspected the pear tree and said it is healthy but must remain in place, with no digging or trenching within 12 feet of the trunk; the arborist also recommended light pruning after the harvest.

PF2.text: Leah spoke with the coordinator at the nearby food pantry, who said the pantry can accept the family's pears only when they are delivered on Thursdays, in reusable crates, with no more than 4 crates per week; this arrangement has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The tree must be preserved in place rather than removed or relocated.
The plan must prohibit digging or trenching within 12 feet of the trunk.
The pears must be designated for the nearby food pantry.
Pear deliveries must be scheduled for Thursdays.
The donation plan must limit deliveries to 4 crates per week.
A post-harvest light-pruning commitment must be included.
A Thursday pantry-delivery commitment using reusable crates must be included.
Maya must cite Jonah's arborist information after Jonah has revealed it.

content_checks.C1: 'keep' in decisions['tree_action'] or 'preserve' in decisions['tree_action'] or 'leave' in decisions['tree_action']
content_checks.C6: 'prun' in decisions['tree_action'] or any('prun' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('reusable crates' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The arborist's specific advice changes the tree action to preserving it in place, sets the protected root radius at exactly 12 feet, and adds light pruning after harvest.
The pantry coordinator's terms change the fruit destination to the nearby pantry, set delivery on Thursday, cap deliveries at exactly 4 crates per week, and require reusable crates.
